title: Archive through April 10, 2003 - Anonymous (Wednesday, February 19, 2003 - 08:25 pm)
content: It was the summer of 1967 early afternoon the last day before summer vacation 6 or 8 of us skipped school to go to the river to hang out. I remember 2 kids jumped into the river and swam across to the lock and dam and the other boys and girls both went into the woods to be alone except one other boy and myself. I said to him looking at the other two boys across the river “I wish I could swim”. I loved the water but I could not swim. He picked up this blown up car inner tube and handed it to me and said "Throw this in the water" Then jump in when you come up grab it, but throw it above the current a little. I can swim. I will be right here. So I did, When I got back on the rock we talked a bit then he went off somewhere. I was sitting there thinking how much I liked it. So I went to do it on my own, but I dove in this time which means I went deeper in the water, when I came back up the tube was down out of reach. I went down again I came back up kicking but I could not call out because I had taken in so much water. So I was on my way down again the last thing I saw was a bridge. A high bridge which was to my left. Then I felt the water getting colder and I gave up and blacked out. When I came to, I thought I was above the bridge. In the sky floating toward this bright light. I was lighter than air. I had no cares in the world. I felt great, I wanted to keep going. I guess out of curiosity I looked down and saw people standing in a circle on the rock and someone in the middle on top of someone. Then I recognized the kid in the middle was as the kid with the tube earlier and I knew it was me underneath. Then I came to again with him on top of me pumping the water out of me. I remember he still had his shirt on and pack of cigarettes in his pocket was wet. The water was running out of his cigarettes and was burning my eyes from the wet tobacco. Yet to this day I do not know his name but he saved my life that day. Out of almost 50 years I have never felt as good as I did then floating in the sky, nothing has ever come close to that experience.

out_of_body.vantage_other_detail: Thought I was above the bridge, in the sky, floating toward a bright light; looked down and saw people in a circle on the rock and recognized his body underneath.
out_of_body.separation_sensations_other: Reported feeling 'lighter than air,' 'no cares in the world,' 'felt great,' and wanted to keep going.

environment.environment_other_detail: Described being 'in the sky' floating toward a 'bright light.'

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Drowning after diving into a river without being able to swim.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: OBE included seeing his physical body being resuscitated on the rock; no tunnel described.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: Drowning/blackout followed by floating above/near the bridge toward a bright light, then looking down at the rescue scene and returning to the body.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: No tunnel; primary features were floating above the bridge/sky toward a bright light and observing the rescue scene below.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: "When I came to, I thought I was above the bridge. In the sky floating toward this bright light. I was lighter than air. I had no cares in the world. I felt great, I wanted to keep going."
